site.name: EverBiohacking
site.tagline: Live longer. Think clearer. Feel better.
site.description: Living protocols for the systems that shape your life — sleep, nutrition, energy, mental health, cognition and longevity. Kept current, not archived.

home.aboutHeading: Hi, I'm Pavel — founder of EverBiohacking.
home.aboutBody: I've been deep in biohacking since 2016 — more than ten years of self-experimentation, tracking my own biomarkers, and reading primary research. I'm a developer, not a doctor, and I've spent the last decade testing what actually moves the needle for energy, cognition, and longevity.
home.aboutBody2: EverBiohacking is what I wish existed when I started — science-backed and grounded in primary research.
home.aboutBody3: It's a lifelong project. Every protocol here is a living document — I edit it whenever what I actually do changes.

about.title: About
about.heading: About EverBiohacking
about.intro: EverBiohacking is a library of living protocols covering the systems that shape your life — sleep, nutrition, cognition, longevity. Built by Pavel, a developer who has spent more than a decade self-experimenting and reading primary research.
about.philosophyBody: Nothing here is medical advice. Everything is grounded in primary research and personal experience, with a bias toward what has held up under repeated experiments. Nothing here is frozen either — a protocol describes what I do now, and I rewrite it when the evidence or the results change.
about.contactBody: Subscribe in the footer. You'll hear from me when a protocol changes — no spam, no schedule.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: EverBiohacking respects your privacy. This page explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.dataBody: We only collect your email address if you voluntarily subscribe to our newsletter. We do not use tracking cookies and do not share data with third parties.
privacy.analyticsBody: We may use anonymous analytics to understand which protocols are read more often. No personal data is collected in this process.

terms.changesBody: We reserve the right to modify these terms. The current version is always available on this page.
